title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter

suppliers.sup:70530: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020 frequency converter 7.5 kW
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer. Our orders with you for part:350020 rose from EUR 400.19 (po:4500012924-10) to EUR 412.74 (po:4500014465-10) between 2025-09-15 and 2026-09-28. That rise is already in our price.
Our should-cost estimate for part:350020 is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020), below your price.
The forecast for part:350020 increased by 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

Our expected volume is 4580 pcs per year. The attached packages offer you a 24- or 36-month commitment for planning security and capacity loading. Could you also tell us your earliest lead time?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020 frequency converter 7.5 kW
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your verified data regarding the volume increase and your should-cost estimate. 

As to the price history and volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. In exchange for the 36-month contract term, which provides valuable planning security, we can offer a revised price of EUR 427.96. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €427.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. We must maintain the 30-day payment term, and our colleagues will address your question regarding lead times. This Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 - part:350020: revised package on your 30-day payment terms
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your revised offer and for checking our data. We have moved toward you. The attached package keeps your 30-day payment terms and your preferred 36-month term. It covers 4580 pcs per year over 36 months, which gives you secure capacity loading and planning until well beyond the period in your head office's freeze.

In your annual review you were open on call-off flexibility. Is there a call-off pattern, such as fixed monthly quantities as in your delivery schedule, that lowers your cost and lets you meet this package? Could you also confirm your earliest lead time?

We would be glad to close this renewal well before your holiday shutdown.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 - part:350020: revised package on your 30-day payment terms
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. Due to the strict price reduction freeze mandated by our head office, we must hold our price at EUR 427.96 for these terms. 

Accordingly, our current offer remains a price of €427.96 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

Our colleagues will address your inquiries regarding call-off flexibility and confirm our earliest lead times.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – revised package and closing question
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for holding your offer open. We have moved our price toward you again in the attached package. It keeps your 36-month term, 4580 pcs per year and your 30-day payment terms.

Two points to consider. First, the attached price is still above our current contract price, so it is a price increase, not a reduction under your head office's freeze. Second, our expiring agreement ctr:4600070530 runs on 90-day payment, so accepting your 30-day terms already eases your cash position noticeably.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

We would be glad to close well before your holiday shutdown.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – revised package and closing question
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

We note your comments regarding the current contract price and the transition to 30-day payment terms. Consequently, we hold our Angebot at EUR 427.96 for a volume of 4580 pieces per year, a 36-month contract, and a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net. 

Please note that our margin and our limits stay internal. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020, revised package
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your reply and for keeping your offer valid. We have moved our price toward you once more. The attached package keeps everything you asked for: your 30-day payment terms, a 36-month term and 4580 pcs per year.

We understand the constraint from your head office. Your sales director mentioned openness on call-off flexibility. If a fixed monthly call-off, as in your delivery schedule, or another arrangement on our side would let you meet this package, please tell us. We are happy to commit to it.

We would value closing this renewal on a stable footing well before your holiday shutdown.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020, revised package
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your revised offer and your willingness to accommodate fixed monthly call-offs. 

Due to the strict price reduction freeze mandated by our head office, we are unable to offer any further price concessions. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Consequently, we must hold our offer at EUR 427.96 for a volume of 4580 pieces per year, a 36-month contract, and a 30-day payment term. 

Specifically, our Angebot remains a price of €427.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – two packages for part:350020
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for keeping your offer valid. We respect your head office's freeze. We have therefore attached two complete packages. Each covers 4580 pcs per year over 36 months.

The first package keeps your 30-day payment terms. Our price moves another step toward you.

The second package uses 60-day payment terms, a step back toward the 90 days in our expiring agreement ctr:4600070530. In return, it sits closer to your price.

Which of the two packages suits your planning better? Is there a payment arrangement that would let you meet it?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – two packages for part:350020
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We appreciate your continued movement and the presentation of multiple packages. 

Regarding your question on payment arrangements, the strict price reduction freeze prevents us from meeting your proposed prices even under different payment terms. 

Consequently, we must hold our offer at EUR 427.96 for a volume of 4580 pieces per year, a 36-month contract, and a 30-day payment term. Specifically, our current Angebot stands at a price of €427.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. The offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
